description: Recovers an operation after operation_get reports reconciliation_required. Use the original write’s idempotency key and confirm one attempt. The receipt identifies the original operation for a follow-up operation_get. If recovery is exhausted, stop and keep the original resource.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: operation_reconcile
